item.title: Celebrating men, challenging stereotypes, building a stronger energy future together
item.dc:creator: Emiliano Bellini
item.description:
On International Men's Day, and as Movember raises awareness of men's health and wellbeing, Women in Solar+ Europe (WiSEu) and Solar+ Leaders celebrate the men across the solar and wider energy transition industries who are helping build a more inclusive future. Carmen Madrid, Founder of both initiatives, draws on perspectives shared throughout the network's pv magazine series to reflect on why gender equality is not about women versus men, but about creating workplaces where everyone can thrive, lead authentically and contribute their full potential to the energy transition.

The post Celebrating men, challenging stereotypes, building a stronger energy future together appeared first on pv magazine Global.

item.title: Spain approves new data center rules requiring 80% renewable electricity
item.dc:creator: Emiliano Bellini
item.description:
The new framework introduces energy and water efficiency standards, renewable electricity procurement obligations, and grid flexibility requirements for data centers. A €17.14 billion transmission network plan will support 47.4 GW of new electricity demand through 2030.

The post Spain approves new data center rules requiring 80% renewable electricity appeared first on pv magazine Global.

item.title: The U.S. solar manufacturing landscape in 2026
item.dc:creator: Mark Hutchins
item.description:
Having watched the global solar industry move from tens of megawatts annual demand to levels in excess of 500 GW by the early 2020s, the United States is finally making moves to create a silicon-based ecosystem to allow its demand for solar to be met by domestically made components. Finlay Colville examines the recent growth in US solar manufacturing.

The post The U.S. solar manufacturing landscape in 2026 appeared first on pv magazine Global.
